summary_1line: Yudhishthira asks Bhishma about the destructible and indestructible; Bhishma begins a teaching through a dialogue between Vasishtha and King Janaka on Brahman and cosmic cycles.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira sits beside the dying Bhishma on his bed of arrows, asking about the indestructible Brahman as sages gather around.
King Janaka stands with folded hands before the radiant sage Vasishtha seated in meditation, asking about the eternal Brahman.
The cosmic being with countless eyes, heads, and limbs spreads across the universe as creation begins from the effulgent Sambhu.
